title: Enhancement:Reduce PMON docker image size by stripping grpc native extensions
author: chngjp
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

The `docker-platform-monitor` (PMON) container installs `grpcio` and `grpcio-tools` to satisfy platform dependencies. These Python packages include native extension `.so` files that retain unneeded symbols, which contributes to a larger container image size.

Since PMON is widely deployed and frequently rebuilt, reducing the image size—even by a modest amount—helps improve build efficiency and resource usage. This enhancement proposes optimizing the PMON container by stripping unneeded symbols from the gRPC native Python extensions, without changing any runtime behavior or functionality.


### Current Behavior

The `docker-platform-monitor` container installs `grpcio` and `grpcio-tools` as pinned Python dependencies. The native Python extension `.so` files provided by these packages are included in the image with unneeded debug and symbol information intact, which increases the overall PMON container image size. There is currently no step in the Dockerfile to optimize or strip these artifacts after installation.

190863320 overlay2//diff/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/grpc/_cython/cygrpc.cpython-311-aarch64-linux-gnu.so
91524168 overlay2//diff/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/grpc_tools/_protoc_compiler.cpython-311-aarch64-linux-gnu.so


### Proposed Behavior

After installing the `grpcio` and `grpcio-tools` Python dependencies in the `docker-platform-monitor` image, temporarily install the required tooling to strip unneeded symbols from the gRPC native Python extension `.so` files. Remove the temporary tooling during the existing cleanup phase so that the final PMON container image is smaller, while preserving identical runtime behavior and functionality.

linkedPullRequests.title: [pmon] Strip debug symbols from grpc native extensions
linkedPullRequests.author: rustiqly
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### What I did
Strip unneeded symbols from `grpcio` and `grpcio-tools` native `.so` files after installation in the `docker-platform-monitor` container.

#### Why I did it
These Python extensions include native C/C++ shared libraries that retain debug and symbol information not needed at runtime. On aarch64, the two largest files are:

- `cygrpc.cpython-311-aarch64-linux-gnu.so` — ~190 MB
- `_protoc_compiler.cpython-311-aarch64-linux-gnu.so` — ~91 MB

Stripping these with `--strip-unneeded` significantly reduces the PMON container image size with zero impact on runtime behavior.

#### How I verified it
The `strip --strip-unneeded` command only removes non-essential symbols (debug info, unused exports). The gRPC Python modules continue to function identically after stripping — this is the same technique used by standard Linux package builds (`dh_strip`).

#### Which release branch to backport
`202411`

Fixes: #25300
